product_summary: Manufacturer/exporter/trader of pressure-sensitive adhesive tapes from Vasai East, Mumbai (est. 2013, per own site). Real product lines listed on sticktapes.com: Stick Kraft Paper Tape, Cello/transparent BOPP tape, Bitumen Flashing Tape (butyl+bitumen with Al foil), Plain HDPE tape (FIBC bag jointing), Transfer Adhesive / D/S Tissue tape, Low Tack tape, White Cross Filament tape, Waterproof tape, 3M Anti-Skid tape, Anti-Slip tape (PVC/PEVA/PET), Holding tape, Fabric tape, White Tissue tape, Water Activated tape, Shrink tape (BOPP), Colored tapes, Duct tape (dark grey/silver), PVC Lane Marking tape, Wire Harness tape (PVC), Conducting tape, Mounting Film tape, Masking tape, Foil tape, Textile tape, Automotive industry tape, Self-adhesive book-binding cloth tape. All are finished self-adhesive tapes/rolls, not glues or protein/cellulose-based adhesives.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader - site self-describes as 'Manufacturer, Exporter and Trader'; product cards repeatedly list third-party brands (3M, Tesa, Classique, Abro, Sansui, Wonder 555) alongside own 'Stick Tapes' brand, which is a clear trader/reseller sign alongside own converting operations.
comment: HS 350699 (adhesives/glues n.e.s., incl. protein/cellulose-based) does not correspond to the actual product line: the company sells pressure-sensitive adhesive TAPES, which classify in Ch. 39 (3919), Ch. 48 (4811) and Ch. 59 (5906), not in Ch. 35. Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground - company is kept and the code is corrected; verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry claimed 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas / chemicals) is a misclassification: actual industry is adhesive tapes / packaging & industrial consumables (plastics converting). Product lines missing from the declaration: paper/kraft and water-activated tapes (4811), cloth/fabric/book-binding tapes (5906), aluminium-foil butyl flashing tape (7607/3919), PVC anti-slip and lane-marking tapes, filament/strapping tape, foam and tissue D/S tapes. Trader signs: multi-brand resale (3M, Tesa, Abro, Sansui, Wonder 555) mixed with own brand. All product data is from the company's own website (https://www.sticktapes.com/, /adhesive-tapes.html, /industrial-tapes.html) - i.e. заявлено, не подтверждено: no customs line or B-L record was checked in this HS-only pass, so no shipment-level corroboration of any specific HS code exists. No PAN/CIN or state registration data was researched (out of scope); state inferred only from site address (Maharashtra) - not verified against registry.
